Why join?

Okay, here's the pitch.

We will keep it quick. Here is what being part of WiCS+ actually looks like, and why people keep showing up.

Who we are

Computer science can feel like a closed door. We prop it open.

WiCS+ started on a simple hunch: the people who feel least welcome in CS are often the ones who would be great at it. So we built the opposite of a locked room. A place where women, gender minorities, and honestly anyone curious can walk in, poke at some code, build real things, and feel like they belong. No gatekeeping. No "you should already know this." Just a bunch of people figuring out cool stuff together, snacks in hand.

For everybodyEvery grade, every gender, every level.
Hands-onYou leave having actually made something.
Actually welcomingLow pressure, high support, zero ego.

Build things you're proud of

  • A fall project you pick yourself.
  • A spring group build with the whole club.
  • A beginner friendly hackathon.
  • A showcase to present your work.

Learn beyond class

  • Weekly sessions on what class skips over.
  • Talks from women in tech and LASA alumni.
  • Workshops you help choose.
  • Handpicked resources in the group chat.

Get a little something back

  • A points leaderboard for snacks, merch, and perks.
  • Real service hours for helping out.
  • Projects worth adding to a resume.
  • Lead roles to grow into.

Feel at home

  • Everyone is genuinely welcome.
  • You are never the only beginner.
  • Low pressure, lots of support.
  • Join in August or in February.

It fits around your life.

Come to what you can and build at your own pace. No pressure, and definitely no attendance police!

Roadmap

How the year goes down.

Everyone leaves having built something, learned something, and made a few friends.

1
Fall

Your own project

Pick something you would love to make and build it at your own pace, with the club to help along the way.

2
Winter

The hackathon

One beginner friendly day, real teams, and a demo at the end. First timers are exactly who it is for.

3
Spring

The group build

The whole club builds one thing together, with a real role for everyone, whatever you like doing.

4
May

The showcase

Present your work to sponsors, mentors, and the school. A nice thing to point to later, too.

What we get into

  • Where CS meets art, medicine, and music.
  • Staying sharp in a world full of AI.
  • The tools real developers use.
  • Friendly competitions, only if you want them.

Leaderboard

Show up, rack up points, win stuff.

Everything you do in WiCS+ earns points. Points climb the board. The board gets you snacks, merch, and legitimate bragging rights. That is the whole system!

How you earn points

Roughly. We reserve the right to hand out bonus points for being awesome.

Come to a meeting+10
Finish the mini-project+5
Give a talk or demo+25
Enter the hackathon+30
Win the hackathon+50
Volunteer at an event+20
Bring a friend who joins+15
Finish your semester project+40
Just being lovely+?
